name: Jar wine
summary: Jar wine is the drink of the Bản Đôn evening, shared around the campfire with xòe dancing and khắp singing. Jars are also sold at Phố Đoàn market.
origin: Bản Đôn and Phố Đoàn, Pù Luông. Source: The Thanh Hoa Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism, 18 Mar 2022 and 16 May 2022.
howToEat: Shared at the evening fire in Bản Đôn, not poured at a bar.
Buy a jar on Thursday or Sunday at Phố Đoàn.
where: Bản Đôn in the evening, and Phố Đoàn on market day.
seoTitle: Jar wine in Pu Luong — the Ban Don evening
seoDescription: Rượu cần is the jar wine of the Bản Đôn campfire, with xòe and khắp, and a good at Phố Đoàn.
